# Client Policy

This version assigns client reliability guidance to the platform team and
explicitly removes the previous numeric request-timeout rule without defining a
replacement timeout.

## Important assertions

- The platform team owns client reliability guidance ([Client Policy claim](../topics/client-policy.md#claim-client-reliability-guidance-ownership)); heading "Ownership", lines 3-8.
